title: Prayer of Mary Who Goes Ahead to Solve the Impossible
purpose: A modern Marian prayer asking the Mother of God to walk ahead of you into what you cannot solve - closed doors, difficult conversations, fears - ending with the traditional Hail Mary.
howToPray: Pray it slowly, name the situation you cannot solve, and let the words carry it; the prayer closes with the traditional Hail Mary.
when: In any situation that feels too big - a closed door, a delay, a fear - whenever you would ask a Mother to go ahead of you.
source: Modern devotional prayer shared by Catholic Prayer (@catholicprayerofc) on Instagram; original reel linked on the page, not re-uploaded.
